entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is 774-B-91.
Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order... I see the Aero Pro cycling shoes. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit right. They're causing problems.
I'm sorry to hear that. Is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference and comfort issue?
They gave me blisters after a long ride. I can't use them. I just need a refund.
I understand, that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Sometimes an adjustment to the cleats can fix pressure points. Have you tried repositioning those?
Look, I've tried everything. I'm busy, I don't have time to tinker with them. Can I return them for a refund, yes or no?
Yes, absolutely. Let me just confirm the purchase date... I see it was delivered 59 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy for standard items.
Great. So what's the next step?

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the cycling shoes in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.
Okay, got the email. Thank you.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
